purpose: Playbook-heterogeneous corpus to fairly test Oscillitron's Thread A router (routes on operation, not subject). See README.md and scratch/dense-router-design.md §2.12.9.
notes: Iteration 8: +15 tasks (3/playbook) depth; re-verified iteration-7 batch (1->2). 26/playbook, 130 total. Fixed 3 duplicate IDs via global per-cell renumber and adopted the id_convention above.
id_convention: <playbook>-<domain>-<NNN>, NNN sequential per (playbook,domain) cell in file order. Renumber-on-write keeps it collision-free.
